method: Read-only original CSV/gzip/tar streams and SQLite mode=ro. No new collection, original mutation or whole-archive extraction. At parent request, only the Kimi op_summary member was copied in1MiB chunks to a reusable temporary CSV for full replay.

definitions.full_model_capture: All retained kernel records from one serving rank/device within the recorded window; does not mean all ranks, entire generation, or identified layer occurrences.
definitions.independent_geometry: Serving command/model config/request receipt independently recorded before observed kernel matching.
definitions.primitive: Standalone tensor/operator call, insufficient for whole-model acceptance.
